name: Lena Düpont - Article 1 – alinéa 1 – point 1; Directive (UE) 2015/637 – Article 7 – après le paragraphe 1 - Am 42
title: REPORT on the draft for a Council directive amending Directive (EU) 2015/637 on the coordination and cooperation measures to facilitate consular protection for unrepresented citizens of the Union in third countries and Directive (EU) 2019/997 establishing an EU Emergency Travel Document
part_text: Amendment 1a. Recognised refugees and other persons who are legally residing in a Member State and are holders of a travel document issued by that Member State shall be entitled to consular protection under the same conditions as unrepresented citizens, if the Member State of residence is not represented by a diplomatic or consular authority.
